contexts.text: When he is delivered, that is, regenerated...
That the rational man... liberated and delivered him. Treated of.
All things in the external man, before he is delivered and liberated, are called servants.
Deliverance. Signified. To go out = to be delivered.
He liberated the World of Spirits from infernal Genii and Spirits, and thus delivered the human race from destruction... therefore He is called the Deliverer, and the Redeemer...
Visitation... signifies either vastation... or deliverance, thus exploration.
God tempts no man, [but] is continually delivering from temptations, so far... as deliverance does not cause evil.
He is here called Jehovah, because it treats of deliverance; for from truth is all temptation and condemnation, but from good is all deliverance and salvation.
Deliverance (after temptation). Signified.

Abraham went and took the ram = their deliverance by virtue of the Lord's Divine Human... He took the ram that was held back in the thicket by its horns = the deliverance of the spiritual by virtue of the Lord's Divine Human.
Redemption is reformation and regeneration, and thence deliverance from Hell, and salvation.
To break his yoke from off thy neck = deliverance... from shutting up and interception...
I have seen God faces to faces, and my soul is delivered () = that He endured the most grievous temptations, as if they were from the Divine.
He rescued (Joseph) out of their hand = deliverance.
Bring me out of this house = deliverance from evils. To bring out = deliverance.
The interior Natural... is then delivered from the evils by which the Celestial... was estranged.
How Joseph was delivered from the pit (i.e. the prison)... His being called out of the pit to Pharaoh = a state of deliverance from temptations.
Man is such evil, that to eternity he cannot be fully delivered, even from one sin...
To a great going out = deliverance from damnation... which deliverance is effected by means of remains.
The Lord's Divine Human by which there is deliverance from Hell. Signified. To redeem = to deliver.
He redeemed man, that is, delivered him from Hell.
This deliverance is what is called Redemption; and the Divine Human itself, which delivered or redeemed, is called the Angel that redeems.

From the prey my son thou hast gone up = that by the Lord through the Celestial is the deliverance of many from Hell. To go up from the prey = deliverance from Hell. Explained... This plucking away and deliverance is what is called the prey; and as this is effected from the Lord's Divine Good, it is said, that by the Lord through the Celestial is the deliverance of many from Hell.
But no one can be plucked away and delivered from Hell, unless in the bodily life he has been in spiritual good... Hence such cannot be plucked away or delivered from Hell...
Deliverance from a state of temptations is what is compared to a hind let loose...
A wolf = the avidity of releasing and delivering the good.
When the Lord is present, there is the release and deliverance of the good.
To be visited... here stands for the deliverance of the Sons of Israel.
To visit = to deliver.

Because I have drawn him out of the waters = deliverance from falsities... To draw out = deliverance... In these words is signified... that the Lord, in order that He might become the Divine Law as to the Human, delivered it from all the falsity which adhered to His Human from the mother.

An Egyptian man hath delivered us from the hands of the shepherds () = that the scientific truth which is adjoined to the Church prevailed over the power of the doctrine of falsity from evil... To deliver = to prevail; for he who delivers from the hand of others, prevails over them.
In this chapter it treats of the deliverance (of those who are of the Church); and then they are instructed who the God is that has delivered them, that it is the Lord.

I have come down to deliver him from the hand of the Egyptians () = that He let Himself down to them to release them from the power of false scientifics... To deliver = to release... for he who releases from falsities, delivers.

In what follows, it treats of the deliverance of the Sons of Israel, that is, of those who are of the Lord's Spiritual Church, from falsities; from which they cannot possibly be delivered, except by the Holy which proceeds from the Lord.

Bring forth my people the Sons of Israel out of Egypt = the deliverance thereby of those who are of the Spiritual Church from the falsities which are infesting them. To bring forth = deliverance. AC 6868. AC 7235. AC 7932 1.2.

I will make you ascend from the affliction of Egypt = elevation and deliverance from infestation by false scientifics. To make to ascend = elevation towards interior things... Hence, also, it = deliverance.
Afterwards he will let you go = the driving away of those who are in falsities, and the deliverance of those who are in truths... To let go = driving away, and thence deliverance.
Continuation in this chapter () concerning the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church.
It here treats in the spiritual sense of the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church, who were delivered by means of the Advent of the Lord into the world. References. AC 7445.
All the miracles performed by the Lord signify... that those were then delivered from Hell who received the faith of charity.
Stubbornness, and thus no deliverance as yet. Signified.

Jehovah hath visited the Sons of Israel = that those of the Spiritual Church were delivered and saved by means of the Advent of the Lord. To visit = deliverance by means of the Advent of the Lord into the world; thus also salvation.

He who is delivered from falsities, and from the straitness in which he then is, thanks God from a glad disposition... The feasts... are also said to have been instituted in memory of the deliverance from slavery in Egypt, that is, ... in memory of the deliverance from infestation by falsities, by means of the Advent of the Lord into the world.

(This) is manifest from the feast of the Passover, which was to be celebrated yearly on the day they went out of Egypt, on account of the deliverance of the Sons of Israel from slavery, that is, on account of the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church from falsities, thus from damnation; and as the Lord delivered them by means of His Advent, and elevated them into Heaven with Himself when He rose again; this, too, was done at the Passover.
And delivering Thou hast not delivered Thy people () = that they have not been released from a state of infestations by falsities.
They are now cheered with hope, and with a promise that they are certainly to be delivered. Treated of.

It was believed that they... would be delivered from infestations at once; when yet it is according to order that the evil who infest should be removed by degrees, and that they who are of the Spiritual Church should be delivered by degrees... They are now instructed about this law, and that it is by virtue of it that they will certainly be delivered, when, according to order, the time and state are come... That Moses, by whom is here represented the Law Divine... believed that they would be at once delivered from infestations, is evident from what he said... Delivering Thou hast not delivered Thy people; by which is signified that they are being too much infested by falsities.

The reason why they who are of the Spiritual Church, and are in the Lower Earth, are delivered from infestations successively, and not at once, is that the inhering evils and falsities cannot be otherwise removed, and goods and truths insinuated in their place; this is effected by means of many changes of state.
Bring forth My army, My people, the Sons of Israel = that they are to be delivered who are in goods and truths. To bring forth = to deliver. AC 7282.

It treats in this chapter () concerning the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church, and the damnation of those who are in faith separated from charity; the damnation of the latter, and the deliverance of the former is represented by the Passover; and the states as to charity and faith of those who have been delivered, by the things which were to be observed during the days of the Passover.
In the supreme sense, by the Passover is represented the damnation of the unfaithful, and the deliverance of the faithful by the Lord, when He has been glorified.

By this month is signified the beginning of the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church... detained in the Lower Earth... Their first state, when delivered, was the principal of all, and the beginning from which proceed all that follow... because they who were there were delivered by means of the Advent of the Lord into the world... and because they were delivered when the Lord rose again.
Between the evenings = the state of the deliverance of those who are in truth from good, and the state of the damnation of those who are in falsity from evil...
When (those who were in the Lower Earth) were being delivered, they were to be prepared to receive the influx of good and truth from the Lord. Signified, Explained.
The worship of the Lord on account of deliverance from damnation. Signified.
Kill the Passover = preparation for the presence of the Lord, and thence deliverance. The Passover = the presence of the Lord, and the deliverance of those who are of the Spiritual Church.
In the internal sense, both in the books of Moses, and in the Prophets, it treats of the deliverance of those who... were detained in the Lower Earth... and of their elevation into Heaven.
This is the sacrifice of the Passover to Jehovah = the worship of the Lord on account of deliverance.
He hath delivered our houses () = that nothing damnable reached them, because they were in goods from the Lord.
To bring them forth from the land of Egypt = deliverance from spiritual captivity. To bring forth = to deliver.
Jehovah hath brought forth the Sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt = that the Lord delivered from damnation those who were in the good of truth and the truth of good. To bring forth = to deliver.
Their deliverance by the Lord, when He rose again, is signified by the Lord's descent to those beneath; and was manifested by the resuscitation of the dead out of the monuments... Illustrated.

It treats in this chapter ()... of the perpetual remembrance, that by Him they have been delivered from damnation. The perpetual remembrance of the deliverance by the Lord is signified by the celebration of the Passover.
That they were delivered by virtue of the Divine power of the Lord. Signified. To bring forth = to deliver.
Deliverance to eternity. Signified. To go forth = to be delivered.
Unceasing worship of the Lord on account of deliverance. Signified.
When they were delivered (from the Lower Earth) they were not immediately taken up into Heaven. Signified, Explained.
The second state after they were delivered. Signified. The journeyings and encampments of the Sons of Israel... signify the spiritual states of those who have been delivered by the Lord.
To cry to Jehovah = to intercede, namely, for deliverance from temptation.

They who are delivered from temptations, first come into an obscure state before they come into a clear one; for the falsities and evils which are injected by the Hells inhere for some time, and are only successively dissipated. Signified.
Glorification of the Lord by those who are of the Spiritual Church on account of deliverance. Signified.
In the end of the former state there shall be a revelation that they have been delivered. Signified.
In my bringing you forth out of the land of Egypt = after they have been delivered from infestations. To bring forth = to deliver.
Hath delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh () = deliverance from the falsity of those who infested.
Jehovah rescued them = deliverance by the Lord's Divine aid. To rescue = deliverance. AC 8676.
Who brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of servants = deliverance from Hell by Him. To bring forth = deliverance.
They of the Spiritual Church... were delivered from Hell by the Lord, by means of His Advent into the world, and His making the Human in Himself Divine. References.
To plead the cause = to defend truths against falsities, and deliver.
To plead the cause of the soul = to defend and deliver from falsities.

Redemption = to give something else in its place, that there may be deliverance... For it here treats of deliverance from damnation, and man can only be delivered from damnation by means of the removal of evil... The deliverance from damnation, or, what is the same, deliverance from sins, is the removal of evil, which is effected through repentance of life. References.
But the Lord continually protects and delivers.
Three times thou shalt keep a feast to Me in the year = the worship of the Lord and permanent thanksgiving on account of deliverance from damnation... Three times... = plenary and entire deliverance.
The successive steps of deliverance from damnation are circumstanced as are the successive steps of regeneration; for regeneration is deliverance from Hell and introduction into Heaven by the Lord...
Deliverance from infestation by falsities. Signified.

The three feasts were instituted on account of the deliverance of man from damnation, thus on account of regeneration; for by means of regeneration man is delivered from Hell and introduced into Heaven...
The second state of deliverance from damnation, which was a state of the implantation of truth in good, was signified (by this second feast).
Worship from a grateful disposition on account of the implantation of good thence, thus on account of regeneration and plenary deliverance from damnation. (Signified by the third feast.)
He who does not know how the case is with the deliverance of man from evils and falsities...
The sins which a man does are inrooted in his very life, and make it; wherefore no one is delivered from them, unless he receives new life from the Lord, which is effected by means of regeneration.
Deliverance from sins, or the remission of them, is nothing else than removal; for they remain with the man...

Purification from the evils and falsities with man, is not deliverance from them, but is the removal of them. References. But with the Lord there was not the removal, but the casting out of those things which He derived from the mother, thus plenary deliverance from them...

Purification or deliverance from evil through acknowledgement and faith that all the truths and goods of faith and love, and their ordination and disposition, are from the Lord, and nothing from man. Signified.

As soon as man believes that goods flow in from the Lord... goods affect him... and in proportion as goods affect man, evils are removed, thus he is purified and delivered from them. (If he cannot feel the influx of goods from the Lord) still he ought to acknowledge and believe that they are from the Lord; for when this is done, he is also delivered from evils, but, in order that he may be delivered from evils, this acknowledgement must be... of the very heart.

To expiate upon their souls = to be purified or delivered from evils by means of the truth of faith; and as purification or deliverance from evils is nothing but their removal, this, too, is signified.

Thou shalt keep the feast of things unleavened = worship of the Lord and thanksgiving on account of deliverance from evil and the falsities of evil... This feast properly = the glorification of the Lord's Human, thus remembrance and thanksgiving on account of it; for by means of it and of the subjugation of the Hells by the Lord, man has deliverance from evils, and salvation. AC 10655:4. AC 10659.
The temptations... by means of which the good can be delivered from their evils.
On the torment of the unhappy, and at last deliverance.
The deliverance of the bound from the pit; it is circumstanced like one who is in travail, when the child comes to the mouth of the matrix. General article. SE 261.
So that he wants to be delivered and loosed from them; for it is impossible for him to deliver himself.
Among the multitude who are delivered from the pit there are a number who are not yet devastated...
Contrive that the suspicion may fall upon another, that they may be thus delivered.
Being delivered from these torments...
He was sent to the lake... but was thence delivered. This day he was sent to a certain place of the damned... being delivered thence, he is now horrified...
By Redemption the Angels understand liberation from evils, and deliverance from falsities in the following passages. Illustrated.
Redemption = deliverance from damnation.

That the Lord redeemed mankind = that He liberated and delivered them from Hell, and from the evils and falsities which constantly rise up thence... and that He continually liberates and delivers them: that He liberated and delivered them was effected by His subjugating the Hells; and that He continually liberates and delivers, by His glorifying His Human.
To cast out demons = to deliver from the falsities of religion.
